title: TAS — AIQG Classification & Attribution Drift (Plan #8)
description: Declared-vs-inferred drift. Axis-1 (per-event): workflow + attribution drift rate, Loki-backed (drift fields promoted onto the aiqg response event). Axis-2 (temporal): per-identity baseline breaks recorded by the classdrift worker, from aiqg.identity_drift_event (TimescaleDB). DISTINCT from the headline-metric drift dashboard.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant id
list.description: Filter by tenant_id. Empty = all tenants.

panels.title: Workflow drift rate (declared vs inferred)
panels.description: Fraction of events carrying a declared workflow whose declared type disagrees with the heuristic. workflow_drift / workflow_declared.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | workflow_drift="true" [$__interval])) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | workflow_declared!="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Attribution drift rate (declared agent vs inferred)
panels.description: Fraction of events carrying a declared agent flagged as cross-source attribution drift. agent_drift / agent_declared.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | agent_drift="true" [$__interval])) / sum(count_over_time({namespace="tas-llm-router"} |= "aiqg response event" | json | tenant_id=~"$tenant" | agent_declared!="" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Declared events (range)
panels.description: Events carrying a declared workflow signal — the drift-rate denominator.

panels.title: Axis-2 — temporal / behavioral drift (per-identity baseline breaks, TimescaleDB)
Identity baseline breaks over time
panels.description: Axis-2 drift breaks recorded by the classdrift worker, bucketed. A rising line = more stable declared identities breaking from their inferred baseline (version churn / impersonation / classifier miscalibration).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS time, signal AS metric, count(*) AS breaks FROM aiqg.identity_drift_event WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$tenant' = '' OR tenant_id = '$tenant') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT signal AS "Signal", count(*) AS "Breaks" FROM aiqg.identity_drift_event WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$tenant' = '' OR tenant_id = '$tenant') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top drifting identities (range)
panels.description: Declared identities with the most Axis-2 breaks. A fingerprint_lineage break = a new agent version or impersonation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent_declared AS "Agent", count(*) AS "Breaks", count(*) FILTER (WHERE signal = 'fingerprint_lineage') AS "Lineage breaks", round(max(divergence)::numeric, 3) AS "Max divergence", max(time) AS "Last break" FROM aiqg.identity_drift_event WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$tenant' = '' OR tenant_id = '$tenant') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Recent breaks
panels.description: Newest Axis-2 identity drift breaks with the tripped signal + divergence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "Time", agent_declared AS "Agent", signal AS "Signal", round(divergence::numeric, 3) AS "Divergence", round(threshold::numeric, 2) AS "Threshold", sample_count AS "Samples", detail AS "Detail" FROM aiqg.identity_drift_event WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('$tenant' = '' OR tenant_id = '$tenant') ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100
